contexts.text: So that he is a mere heap and compound of evils and the derivative falsities. AC 987. AC 2694:4.
Let them heap corn () = every good of truth together. To heap = to gather together, and to preserve.
Joseph heaped corn as the sand of the sea () = the multiplication of truth from good. To heap, here, = to multiply.
From the inordinated heap of things (in the memory).
The man himself does not see this heap or conglomeration of them...
In the... mind... there are heaps of ideas...
All the heaps... were carried away by the... winds.
4. 2. The mass of the two interior degrees... was in the order and form of Heaven; but the mass of the lowest degree... was in the form of Hell.
